errors.text_span: 10,59 Euro für 60 % des Medianlohns im Jahr 2015
errors.evidence: Description states 10,59 Euro for 60 % of the median wage in 2015, but the figure shows 10,82.
Description states 12,82 Euro for the statutory minimum wage in 2025, but the figure shows 12,41.
The description fails to mention the dashed pattern for the bars representing 2024 and 2025.
The description does not specify that the values above the bars are not included in the figure.
